calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor for an ASE atoms structure using pymatgen and an ASE calculator
compute_bulk_modulus: compute the bulk modulus VRH for a crystal structure by running elasticity calculations with normal strains
compute_shear_modulus: compute the shear modulus VRH for a crystal structure by running elasticity calculations with shear strains
relax_and_deform_structure: relax an initial structure then apply normal and shear strains to compute stresses for elasticity
use_equilibrium_stress: use equilibrium stress from a relaxed structure to improve accuracy of the elastic tensor calculation
